title: zhao environment variables
description: Environment variables the zhao extension passes to every zhao/dbt process it runs.

variables.description: Variable name to value. Values may reference ${env:NAME} (from VS Code's own environment) or ${OTHER} (another variable here).

envFile.description: One or more .env files, relative to the workspace folder. Later entries win. Values in .env files take precedence over values in this JSON.

sets.description: Named sets (e.g. one per client or environment). The active set, chosen in the zhao sidebar, is layered over the base.
